title: Santa Maria Tri-Tip Roast
seoTitle: Santa Maria Tri-Tip Roast | Firehall BBQ
shortDescription: West Coast tri-tip that slices fast and feeds the whole hall
subtitle: California salt-pepper-garlic rub, oak smoke, and salsa for ten
description: Adapted from classic Santa Maria tri-tip tradition (Amazing Ribs, Weber): tri-tip gets a salt-pepper-garlic rub, smokes over oak at 275°F to 130°F, then sears and slices against the grain with pinquito beans and salsa.

steps.title: Season Santa Maria-style
steps.instruction: Mix salt, pepper, and garlic. Coat tri-tip with oil, then pack rub on all sides. Rest 30 minutes while smoker heats to 275°F with oak.

steps.title: Smoke to 130°F
steps.instruction: Smoke tri-tip at 275°F until internal temp reaches 125–130°F for medium-rare, about 45–55 minutes.

steps.title: Sear over high heat
steps.instruction: Sear over direct heat at 450°F+ 3–4 minutes per side until crust forms and internal temp reaches 135°F for medium.

steps.title: Rest and slice
steps.instruction: Rest 10 minutes. Slice against the grain into thin slices—tri-tip grain changes direction; rotate as you cut.

steps.title: Hold at 170°F
steps.instruction: Toss slices lightly with warm beef broth. Cover with foil and hold at 170°F until service.

steps.title: Warm the beans, keep the pico cold
steps.instruction: Heat pinto beans in a pot. Set pico de gallo cold on the line.

steps.title: Tonight's board
steps.instruction: Sliced tri-tip, beans, salsa, optional tortillas. Call temps: pulled at 135°F medium, held at 170°F.

steps.title: Leftovers
steps.instruction: Slice thin for tri-tip sandwiches with salsa and mayo. Reheat in broth at 325°F until 145°F.

proTips: Tri-tip grain shifts mid-roast—pay attention when slicing or bites turn chewy.
125°F off smoke + sear gets you medium-rare; push to 130°F before sear for medium.
Oak is traditional; hickory works if that's what's in the pit.
tonightSpread: Sliced tri-tip on a board with jus.
Warm pinto beans and tortillas, with cold pico de gallo on the side.
leftovers: Tri-tip tacos with salsa and avocado.
Chop into a steak salad with ranch.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Tri-tip cooks in under two hours and slices like steak night without the cost. Holds sliced at 170°F with jus for 45 minutes.
mealPrepNotes: Season 30 minutes ahead. Smoke to 130°F, sear hot, rest 10 minutes, slice. Hold sliced tri-tip covered at 170°F with beef jus.

adaptable.label: Gluten-Free Adaptable
adaptable.note: Use a certified gluten-free broth or bouillon. Use certified gluten-free tortillas or corn tortillas.
